title: From Self-Normal-Positioning to Omni-Directional Tracking: Real-Time Surface Modeling Enabled Probe Tilt Control for Robotic Ultrasound Imaging
summary: Ultrasound (US) provides real-time, radiation-free imaging, but the image quality depends strongly on how the probe is oriented against the patient body. Robotic US can reduce operator workload and improve acquisition consistency; however, most existing systems focus on normal positioning, where the probe is maintained perpendicular to the local surface. This constraint is inadequate for examinations like echocardiography, where obtaining a diagnostic view requires a non-normal probe angle. Consequently, a clinically useful robotic system must sense the local surface in real-time and preserve the desired probe orientation. Here, we propose an omni-directional probe-orientation control framework that integrates RGB-D perception, local-surface modeling, and task-space orientation control. The surface model fuses multi-view point clouds and provides a quadratic estimate of the local surface. A desired imaging direction is then encoded relative to the normal, enabling the probe to track arbitrary angles. The framework was evaluated through flat-surface tracking, phantom target-angle recovery, and in-vivo tracking of an expert selected view. Results show that the mean angular tracking error was 1.06 +- 0.66 deg. The system recovered a non-normal tilt angle of up to 44.39 +- 2.59 deg relative to the surface normal, and acquired the desired heart chamber view in the phantom and in-vivo experiments.
tldr: This paper presents an omni-directional probe-orientation control framework for robotic ultrasound that uses RGB-D perception and real-time surface modeling to track arbitrary probe angles, achieving low angular tracking error and enabling non-normal views for exams like echocardiography.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种用于机器人超声的全向探头方向控制框架，利用RGB-D感知和实时表面建模来跟踪任意探头角度，实现了低角度跟踪误差，并支持如超声心动图等检查所需的非垂直视角。
summary_zh: 超声（US）可提供实时、无辐射的成像，但图像质量强烈依赖于探头相对于患者身体的朝向。机器人超声能够降低操作者负担并提高采集一致性；然而，现有系统大多聚焦于垂直定位，即探头保持垂直于局部表面。这一约束对于超声心动图等检查并不适用，因为获取诊断视图需要非垂直的探头角度。因此，临床有用的机器人系统必须实时感知局部表面并保持期望的探头朝向。本文提出了一种全向探头朝向控制框架，整合了RGB-D感知、局部表面建模以及任务空间朝向控制。该表面模型融合多视角点云，并提供局部表面的二次估计。随后，相对于法线编码期望的成像方向，使探头能够跟踪任意角度。通过平面跟踪、仿体目标角度恢复以及专家选定视图的活体跟踪对该框架进行了评估。结果表明，平均角度跟踪误差为1.06 ± 0.66度。系统可恢复相对于表面法线高达44.39 ± 2.59度的非垂直倾斜角，并在仿体和活体实验中获取了期望的心脏腔室视图。

title: Topology-Aware Query Selection for Surgical Instrument Instance Segmentation
summary: Accurate foreground masks can still form an incorrect surgical-instrument instance set: duplicate, fragmented, merged, missed, or empty-frame predictions may preserve favorable pixel overlap while violating object identity and count. Final query selection is therefore a relational, variable-cardinality problem rather than a collection of independent candidate decisions. We evaluate topology-aware query selection, which represents the nonempty candidates of a fixed Mask2Former as a complete graph, learns relational candidate and pair representations, predicts set cardinality, and solves an exact structured subset problem. The formal comparison is the complete relational path versus a node-feature-matched path; it evaluates the combined effect of pairwise geometry, message passing, and the additional relational-path capacity, not an isolated component. On the sealed 22-case source test, all three discovery seeds supported instance-set performance improvement with segmentation fidelity and predefined technical-safety preservation: instance F1 increased by 0.0504--0.0612 and positive-frame set-failure rate decreased by 0.0848--0.1060. Direct ROBUST-MIPS transfer reproduced the complete result in all three seeds. Endoscapes supported only one of three seeds and therefore did not establish stable direct transfer. Taken together, the results support a bounded conclusion: the evaluated complete path improved coherent instance-set construction from fixed Mask2Former candidates in specified native-instance contracts, while stable cross-domain transfer and component-specific effects remain unestablished.
tldr: This paper proposes a topology-aware query selection method for surgical instrument instance segmentation, which reframes query selection as a relational, variable-cardinality problem using a complete graph over Mask2Former candidates, and demonstrates improvements in instance F1 and set-failure rate on surgical datasets.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种面向手术器械实例分割的拓扑感知查询选择方法，将查询选择重新定义为关系型变量基数问题，通过构建Mask2Former候选的完全图，并在手术数据集上提升了实例F1和集合失败率。
summary_zh: 准确的掩膜仍可能生成错误的手术器械实例集：重复、碎片化、合并、缺失或空帧的预测虽能保持较高的像素重叠率，却违背了对象同一性与计数要求。因此，最终查询选择是一个关系型、可变基数问题，而非独立候选决策的简单集合。我们评估了拓扑感知查询选择方法：将固定Mask2Former的非空候选表示为完全图，学习关系型候选及其配对表征，预测集合基数，并求解精确的结构化子集问题。其形式化对比为完整关系路径与节点特征匹配路径；该方法评估了成对几何约束、消息传递及额外关系路径容量的综合效应，而非孤立组件。在密封的22例源测试中，所有三个发现种子均支持实例集性能提升，同时保持了分割保真度与预定义技术安全性：实例F1提升了0.0504至0.0612，正帧集合故障率降低了0.0848至0.1060。ROBUST-MIPS的直接迁移在所有三个种子上完整重现了该结果。Endoscapes仅支持三个种子中的一个，因此未能建立稳定的直接迁移。综合而言，结果支持有限结论：所评估的完整路径在特定原生实例契约中，从固定Mask2Former候选改进了连贯实例集的构建，而跨域稳定迁移及组件特定效应仍未被证实。

title: Social Chain of Thought: A Multi-Agent Architecture Grounded in Medical Differential Diagnosis Methodology
summary: Medical diagnostic reasoning is a high-impact use case for LLMs that carries significant implications for the health and wellbeing of users. When OpenAI (2026) reports that more than 5% of ChatGPT messages globally are healthcare-related, the transparency of these systems becomes a serious design concern. This is especially true for complex cases, where differential diagnosis often requires integrating multiple forms of specialist reasoning. Existing work has proposed multi-agent approaches to medical diagnosis, but it remains unclear when such systems are needed, why they help, and where they outperform monolithic inference. We introduce Social Chain of Thought (SCoT),a multi-round pipeline for medical differential diagnosis that structures multi-agent interaction as a deliberative framework for collabora. tive LLM reasoning. Evaluating SCoT against single-agent baselines, one-agent pipeline ablations, and best-of-n scaling, we show that its recall advantage is not reproduced by monolithic inference alone. SCoT is most successful in the hardest diagnostic cases, where multiple rounds of specialist conversation help recover ground-truth diagnoses and converge on a higher-recall differential.
tldr: Introduces Social Chain of Thought (SCoT), a multi-agent pipeline for medical differential diagnosis that uses structured multi-round specialist conversations to improve recall on complex cases, outperforming monolithic and single-agent baselines.
tldr_zh: 提出社会思维链（SCoT），一种用于医学鉴别诊断的多智能体流水线，通过结构化多轮专家对话提升复杂病例的召回率，优于单一模型和单智能体基线。
summary_zh:
摘要：  
医学诊断推理是大语言模型（LLM）的一项高影响力应用场景，对用户的健康与福祉具有重大意义。当OpenAI（2026年）报告称全球超过5%的ChatGPT消息与医疗保健相关时，这些系统的透明度便成为一项严肃的设计考量。这一点在复杂病例中尤为突出，因为鉴别诊断往往需要整合多种形式的专科推理。现有研究已提出多智能体方法用于医学诊断，但目前尚不清楚何时需要此类系统、为何它们能发挥作用，以及在哪些方面它们优于单一模型推理。我们提出“社会思维链”（Social Chain of Thought，SCoT），这是一种用于医学鉴别诊断的多轮流水线方法，将多智能体交互构建为协作式LLM推理的审议框架。通过与单智能体基线、单智能体流水线消融实验以及最优规模扩展方法的比较评估，我们发现其召回率优势无法仅通过单一模型推理复制。SCoT在最具挑战性的诊断案例中表现最为成功，此时多轮专科对话有助于恢复真实诊断结果，并收敛至更高召回率的鉴别诊断列表。

title: Clinical Feasibility of Low-Magnification Fluorescence Imaging for Breast Cancer Margin Detection Using Texture Analysis and Deep Learning
summary: High-resolution images of unprocessed surgical breast tissue can be obtained using microscopy with ultraviolet surface excitation (MUSE). This technique is considered a promising method for checking surgical margins during breast cancer surgery. In this study, MUSE images at 4x and 10x magnifications were compared using patch-level classification methods. Texture analysis (TA) based on local binary patterns (LBP) and deep learning (DL) with a base Vision Transformer (ViT) model were used. Both methods achieved similar performance at both magnifications. Using DL method, both 4x and 10x magnifications achieved 96.30% sensitivity, 100% specificity and 98.18% accuracy. Using TA method, 4x achieved better specificity (100% vs 93.33%) and 10x yielded higher sensitivity (100% vs 93.33%), but both had the same accuracy (96.67%). No clear improvement in performance was observed with 10x magnification. These results show that 4x imaging achieves the same diagnostic accuracy as 10x imaging. At the same time, 4x offers a larger field of view and faster image capture. Therefore, lower magnification can be effectively used in MUSE systems for accurate and efficient intraoperative margin assessment.
tldr: This paper demonstrates that low-magnification (4x) MUSE fluorescence imaging achieves the same diagnostic accuracy as 10x for breast cancer margin detection using both texture analysis and deep learning, supporting its clinical feasibility for faster intraoperative assessment.
tldr_zh: 本文证明低倍率（4倍）MUSE荧光成像在使用纹理分析和深度学习进行乳腺癌切缘检测时，与10倍成像具有相同的诊断准确率，支持其在术中更快速评估的临床可行性。
summary_zh: 利用显微镜紫外表面激发（MUSE）技术可获取未经处理的乳腺手术组织的高分辨率图像。该技术被认为是乳腺癌手术中检查手术切缘的一种有前景的方法。本研究通过斑块级分类方法比较了4倍和10倍放大下的MUSE图像，分别采用了基于局部二值模式（LBP）的纹理分析（TA）和基于视觉Transformer（ViT）基础模型的深度学习（DL）方法。两种方法在两种放大倍数下均取得了相似的表现。使用深度学习方法时，4倍和10倍放大均达到96.30%的敏感性、100%的特异性和98.18%的准确率。使用纹理分析方法时，4倍放大获得了更高的特异性（100% vs 93.33%），10倍放大则获得了更高的敏感性（100% vs 93.33%），但两者准确率相同（96.67%）。10倍放大并未观察到明显的性能提升。这些结果表明，4倍成像与10倍成像具有相同的诊断准确率，同时4倍成像提供更大的视野和更快的图像采集速度。因此，低倍放大可有效应用于MUSE系统，实现准确高效的术中切缘评估。

title: A corpus-specific clinical RAG system matches or outperforms newer frontier LLMs on HealthBench
summary: General-purpose large language models (LLMs) have recently been reported to match or exceed specialized clinical AI tools on medical benchmarks, but such comparisons draw on a narrow set of systems and on benchmarks developed largely in high-income settings. We evaluate VITA, a retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) system purpose-built for contextual knowledge retrieval in India and other low- and middle-income (LMIC) settings. VITA retrieves from a curated corpus of disease-specific guidelines, India-specific antimicrobial resistance data, national formulary constraints, and resource-limited care protocols; its architecture and corpus are proprietary, but the benchmark, the physician-written rubrics, and our full response and scoring outputs are public for independent verification. On 4,023 English-language HealthBench questions (80.5% of the benchmark), scored with a GPT-4.1 judge, VITA ranked first with 51.9% of possible rubric points, ahead of GPT-5.4 (46.1%), o4-mini (44.3%), Gemini 3.1 Pro (42.6%), and Claude Sonnet 4.6 (37.3%), and scored highest on 45.4% of questions. To test robustness to newer models and judge lineage, a 500-question subset was re-run against current-generation models (GPT-5.5, Claude Opus 4.8, Gemini 3.5 Pro, Grok 4.3) and graded by a neutral open-weight judge (DeepSeek-V4-Pro) sharing no lineage with any system tested. Here the gap narrowed to parity: VITA and GPT-5.5 were statistically indistinguishable on mean per-question score, while VITA led on points-weighted score and won the most questions. VITA's advantages in accuracy and completeness persisted under the neutral judge; its communication scores were lower. These results indicate that a purpose-built clinical RAG system remains competitive with frontier LLMs on an open benchmark, consistent with corpus specificity as a design variable that improves grounding at some cost to communication polish.
tldr: VITA, a purpose-built clinical RAG system for low- and middle-income settings, matches or outperforms frontier LLMs on the HealthBench benchmark, demonstrating that corpus specificity can improve grounding at the cost of communication polish.
tldr_zh: VITA是一个专为低收入和中等收入国家设计的临床检索增强生成系统，在HealthBench基准测试上与前沿大语言模型表现相当或更优，表明语料库特异性可提升接地性但会牺牲沟通流畅度。
summary_zh: 通用大语言模型（LLM）近期在医学基准测试中被报道可匹配或超越专业临床AI工具，但此类比较仅基于少数系统以及主要在高收入环境中开发的基准。我们评估了专门为印度及其他中低收入国家（LMIC）环境下的情境知识检索而构建的检索增强生成（RAG）系统——VITA。该系统从经过筛选的疾病特定指南、印度特定抗菌药物耐药性数据、国家处方集限制以及资源有限条件下的护理方案语料库中进行检索；其架构与语料库为专有资产，但基准测试、由医生编写的评分标准以及我们的完整回答与评分结果均为公开内容，可供独立验证。在由GPT-4.1裁判评分的4,023道英语HealthBench问题（占基准的80.5%）中，VITA以51.9%的可得评分点排名第一，领先于GPT-5.4（46.1%）、o4-mini（44.3%）、Gemini 3.1 Pro（42.6%）和Claude Sonnet 4.6（37.3%），并在45.4%的问题上获得最高分。为测试对更新模型的鲁棒性以及裁判模型谱系的影响，我们选取500道问题的子集，使用当前一代模型（GPT-5.5、Claude Opus 4.8、Gemini 3.5 Pro、Grok 4.3）重新运行，并由与任何测试系统无谱系关联的中立开源权重裁判（DeepSeek-V4-Pro）进行评分。此时差距缩小至持平：在每题平均得分上，VITA与GPT-5.5在统计上无显著差异，而VITA在加权得分上领先，并在最多问题中胜出。在中立裁判下，VITA在准确性与完整性方面的优势仍然保持；但其沟通得分较低。这些结果表明，在开放基准测试中，一个为特定目的构建的临床RAG系统仍能与前沿LLM保持竞争力，这与语料库特异性作为一个设计变量可改善事实依据但需在一定程度上牺牲沟通流畅性相一致。
